parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The first law of thermodynamics may be expressed as

$$\Delta U = (+q) + (+w)$$

where $\Delta U$ is the increase in internal energy of the system.

State the meaning of:

$+q$ ......................................................

$+w$ ......................................................

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The variation with pressure $p$ of the volume $V$ of a fixed mass of an ideal gas is shown in Fig. 2.1.
{{figure:figure_2_1.png}}

The gas undergoes a cycle of changes A to B to C to A.

During the change A to B, the volume of the gas increases from $2.3 \times 10^{-3} \text{m}^3$ to $3.8 \times 10^{-3} \text{m}^3$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Show that the magnitude of the work done during the change A to B is $390 \text{J}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State and explain the total change, if any, in the internal energy of the gas during one complete cycle.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
During the change A to B, $1370 \text{J}$ of thermal energy is transferred to the gas.

During the change B to C, no thermal energy enters or leaves the gas. The work done on the gas during this change is $550 \text{J}$.

Use these data and the information in (b) to complete Table 2.1.
